scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test
scripts.db:migrate:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply dayarampur-staging --remote --env staging
scripts.db:migrate:production: wrangler d1 migrations apply dayarampur-production --remote --env production
scripts.db:seed: tsx scripts/seed.ts > .seed.sql && wrangler d1 execute dayarampur-dev --local --file .seed.sql
scripts.db:seed:images: node scripts/seed-images.mjs > .seed-images.sql && sh .seed-images/upload.sh && wrangler d1 execute dayarampur-dev --local --file .seed-images.sql
scripts.db:studio: wrangler d1 execute dayarampur-dev --local --command "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' ORDER BY name"
scripts.cf:deploy:staging: vinext build && vinext-cloudflare deploy --config dist/server/wrangler.json --env staging
scripts.cf:deploy:production: vinext build && vinext-cloudflare deploy --config dist/server/wrangler.json --env production
